title: 3-SPEED AUTO. TRANS.-CONTENTS
summary: Contents of the M40 option section (3-speed Turbo Hydra-Matic automatic transmission): console trim plates and seals, transmission-to-engine installation, shift control cable, brake pedal, downshift (detent) control switch and wiring, neutral safety switch, vacuum modulator pipe, rear axle and propeller shaft (driveshaft), oil cooler lines, crossmember mounting and exhaust clamp, tunnel filler panel and carpet, and the ignition interlock (back drive) linkage. Sheet A17 is cancelled. The drawing shows the VIN location on the transmission (see UPC 0 sheet B2).
notes: V.I.N. LOCATION-See UPC 0, Sheet B2 for specs.
notes_internal: Index page: no parts. Table copied from the two-column contents list.
